points.title: Written guideline for all units
points.text: A written style guideline now exists that every future unit will follow, with the Knight as its example. Its model sheet is drawn and ready for you to judge.

points.title: Knight's new walk and attack
points.text: The Knight now has a heavier, stylised walk and one attack drawn in 14 frames. Both can be played beside today's Knight so you can compare them.
